messages.text: BL-1749 🎵 in progress — BL-877 scenario 7 ('a host with no working liveness facility says so') is red on Linux once BL-1738 fixes its fixture root: its 'no liveness facility can be reached' step forces only lsof unavailable (SWARMFORGE_LSOF_BIN) on the premise that /proc is already absent on the macOS dev host, so on this Linux host the sandbox sweep reads the real /proc and never logs 'liveness could not be determined this pass'; the step also points SWARMFORGE_PROC_DIR at a path that does not exist
